name: synapse
description: Claude Code integration for Synapse memory: pushes session transcripts to your Synapse (ingest), wires up the recall/remember MCP tools, and optionally two-way-syncs your skills library and mirrors opted-in config files for the dream lane. Point it at a local or central Synapse.

SYNAPSE_URL.title: Synapse URL
SYNAPSE_URL.description: Base URL of your Synapse server (no path), e.g. https://synapse.example.net or http://localhost:8765

SYNAPSE_INGEST_TOKEN.title: Synapse token
SYNAPSE_INGEST_TOKEN.description: Your Synapse server's enrollment token (or leave blank for an open/local server, or run `! synapse-login` in the Claude prompt to fetch it). On first session this machine trades it for its own device token, stored right back here — a device token can be revoked on its own, and what this machine is served depends on it.

SYNAPSE_MACHINE_ROLE.title: This machine's role
SYNAPSE_MACHINE_ROLE.description: "personal" (default) or "work". Sent once at enrollment as a REQUEST, not a grant: it becomes the default trust level offered when you approve this device from an already-trusted machine. "work" asks for restricted access — work-safe notes plus an allowlist of projects — so personal memory is never served here.

SYNAPSE_SKILLS_SYNC.title: Two-way skill sync
SYNAPSE_SKILLS_SYNC.description: Opt-in: set to 1 to sync your ~/.claude/skills library with Synapse at session start (dream→skills lane). OFF by default — nothing writes into your skills directory unless you enable it.

SYNAPSE_CONFIG_SYNC.title: Mirror config files
SYNAPSE_CONFIG_SYNC.description: Opt-in: mirror your config into Synapse for the dream lane. OFF by default — your CLAUDE.md + rules/*.md stay on this machine unless you set this to 1, which auto-grabs them from ~/.claude and the current project's .claude.

SYNAPSE_CONFIG_PATHS.title: Extra config globs
SYNAPSE_CONFIG_PATHS.description: Optional EXTRA globs (relative to ~/.claude) to mirror beyond the auto-discovered CLAUDE.md + rules/*.md, e.g. "output-styles/*.md".
